rules: Always use the Oxford comma.
raw: please bring snacks drinks and napkins to the meetup on Thursday
reference: Please bring snacks, drinks, and napkins to the meetup on Thursday.

rules: - use the oxford comma in every series
raw: the report covers revenue costs and hiring plans for next quarter
reference: The report covers revenue, costs, and hiring plans for next quarter.

rules: Write numbers under ten as words.
raw: we have three open bugs and twelve tickets in the backlog
reference: We have three open bugs and 12 tickets in the backlog.

rules: Numbers one to nine: spell them out. 10 and up: digits.
raw: I ran five kilometers this morning and it took about twenty eight minutes
reference: I ran five kilometers this morning, and it took about 28 minutes.

rules: No exclamation marks, ever.
raw: wow that's amazing news congratulations to the whole team we did it
reference: Wow, that's amazing news. Congratulations to the whole team. We did it.

rules: Use 'customers', not 'clients'.
raw: our clients have been asking for a dark mode so let's prioritize it for the next release
reference: Our customers have been asking for a dark mode, so let's prioritize it for the next release.

rules: Format lists with dashes, not numbers.
raw: a few things for tomorrow first send the invoice to Acme second update the roadmap doc and third book flights for the offsite
reference:
A few things for tomorrow:

- Send the invoice to Acme.
- Update the roadmap doc.
- Book flights for the offsite.

rules: Write OK, not okay.
raw: so the build passed and I think we're okay to ship on Monday
reference: So the build passed, and I think we're OK to ship on Monday.

rules: Our product is spelled VoiceIQ (capital V, I and Q).
raw: I've been using voice iq for dictation and it's way faster than typing
reference: I've been using VoiceIQ for dictation, and it's way faster than typing.

rules: Use 24-hour time.
raw: let's meet at three thirty in the afternoon on Friday
reference: Let's meet at 15:30 on Friday.

rules: Dates: DD/MM/YYYY
raw: the deadline is March fourth twenty twenty seven
reference: The deadline is 04/03/2027.

rules: Spell out percent instead of using the % sign.
raw: conversion went up by twelve percent last week
reference: Conversion went up by 12 percent last week.

rules: Don't use contractions in anything I write.
raw: I don't think we can make it on time but we'll try our best and I'll let you know
reference: I do not think we can make it on time, but we will try our best, and I will let you know.

rules: Always call our team 'the platform team', never 'infra'.
raw: infra is going to handle the database migration this weekend
reference: The platform team is going to handle the database migration this weekend.

rules: Write rupee amounts with the ₹ symbol.
raw: the hotel costs four thousand five hundred rupees a night
reference: The hotel costs ₹4,500 a night.

rules: Abbreviate metric units (km, kg, cm).
raw: the box weighs about twelve kilograms so we'll need two people to carry it
reference: The box weighs about 12 kg, so we'll need two people to carry it.

rules: When I list tasks, make each one a checkbox: - [ ] task

Things to do today:

- [ ] Call the bank
- [ ] Renew my passport
- [ ] Pick up the dry cleaning
